map.根据患者性别、年龄与适应症，推荐 Foley 导尿管 Fr 型号、球囊容量及类型: Recommends Foley catheter French size, balloon capacity and type based on patient sex, age and indication
map.导尿管选型：成人男性 16Fr、女性 14Fr、儿童 8 至 10Fr、婴儿 6: Catheter selection: adult male 16Fr, female 14Fr, children 8 to 10Fr, infants 6 to 8Fr two-way Foley; for hematuria or postoperative bleeding choose 18 to 24Fr three-way plus a 30mL balloon for continuous bladder irrigation; for difficult catheterization from prostate or stricture choose a Coude curved tip.
map.尿道狭窄/前列腺增大插管困难: Difficult catheterization from urethral stricture/enlarged prostate
map.Fr（French/Charrière）：1 Fr = 1/3 mm 外径周长。: Fr (French/Charriere): 1 Fr = 1/3 mm of outer circumference. The balloon is labeled by capacity; generally instill an equal or slightly larger amount of sterile water.
map.常规留置导尿（引流+球囊固定）: Routine indwelling catheterization (drainage plus balloon anchoring)
map.持续膀胱冲洗（术后/血尿），进水+出水+球囊: Continuous bladder irrigation (postoperative/hematuria): inflow plus outflow plus balloon
map.尿道狭窄/前列腺增大插管困难，弯头跨越前列腺: Difficult catheterization from stricture/enlarged prostate; the curved tip passes over the prostate
map.在满足引流前提下选最小型号以减少尿道损伤与感染。\n 血尿/术后需冲洗:
Choose the smallest size that still drains adequately, to reduce urethral trauma and infection.
For hematuria or postoperative irrigation choose a larger-bore three-way; for difficult insertion choose a Coude tip or switch to silicone; for long-term indwelling prefer all-silicone or antimicrobial-coated catheters to reduce encrustation and CAUTI.
map.⚠️ 本工具仅供临床参考，实际选择需结合患者尿道解剖、病情与无菌操作规范。: ⚠️ This tool is for clinical reference only; actual selection must integrate the patient's urethral anatomy, condition and aseptic technique standards.
map.成人男性常规留置 16Fr、球囊 10mL 双腔 Foley；血尿/血块冲洗选: Routine indwelling in adult males uses a 16Fr two-way Foley with a 10 mL balloon; for hematuria/clot irrigation choose 18-22Fr three-way.
map.前列腺术后选 22Fr 三腔 Foley（球囊 30mL 牵引止血），乳胶过敏换: After prostate surgery choose a 22Fr three-way Foley (30 mL balloon for traction hemostasis); switch to silicone if latex allergy.
map.按性别/年龄/适应症：男性 16、女性 14、儿童 8-10Fr；血尿或术后加大: By sex/age/indication: male 16, female 14, children 8-10Fr; for hematuria or after surgery go larger and choose a three-way.
map.常规成人留置导尿用 10 mL；前列腺术后或预计有出血时选 20–30 mL 以: Routine adult indwelling uses 10 mL; after prostate surgery or when bleeding is expected choose 20-30 mL to compress the bladder neck for hemostasis; children use 3-5 mL. An oversized balloon irritates the trigone and causes spasm and leakage, while an undersized one slips out easily.
